siteDescription: A place to share your thoughts anonymously

mt.invitePlaceholder: Search people or create any mentor
mt.artifactPlaceholder: Write what’s weighing on you. The table will listen.
mt.aiDisclaimer: This is an AI-simulated perspective inspired by public information, not a real statement from the person.
mt.dataFlowNote: Your text is sent to the MentorTable API and forwarded to a third-party LLM provider to generate replies. Conversations are not stored on our servers; the provider processes each request under its own policy. Avoid sharing identifying details.
mt.noteDeliveryFailed: Couldn't reach {name} — the note wasn't delivered. Try again.
mt.concernHint: Place your concern artifact on the table.
mt.hoverPause: Hover to pause and read carefully.
mt.savedInDrawer: Saved to the Memories drawer in the bottom-right.
mt.needAtLeastOne: Please add at least one guest to continue.
mt.onboardingWelcomeBody: Throw your question at a table of famous people, fictional characters, or personality types — each one gives you advice from their own perspective. It's like chatting with Einstein, Doraemon, and your favorite game character all at once.
mt.onboardingHowBody:
1. Search and add who you want advice from (celebrities, MBTI types, cartoon/game/movie characters — all work)
2. Describe your problem
3. Hit start and wait for each one to reply

You can also follow up with one person, or ask everyone at once.
mt.onboardingReadyBody: Save useful replies to the memory drawer (bottom-right) for later. Choose whether to show this guide next time, then jump in!
mt.adviceLanguageHint: Replies can be generated in any of the five interface languages.
mt.generateFailed: Could not reach the mentors. Please retry.
mt.generateFailedHint: The network or service may be temporarily unavailable. Your session is saved — try again in a moment.
mt.noResults: No results — press Enter to add as custom mentor
mt.customMentorHelper: Search a person, role, or character — or create your own, such as “Future Me.”
mt.customMentorHint: Uses a general AI persona; you can still ask questions and follow up.
